=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25290-25307 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new implementation-PR resolver fallback (25290-25304/25307) resolves and fetches the PR into `_std_prefetched_impl_pr_json`, but does not pass that payload to `invoke_stall_judge` (judge call at 25644). The judge then repeats the work through `_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last` (timeline call, no memoization per lines 4854-4870) and `_fetch_pr_json` (fresh `pulls/N` call, line 2534-2538, linked PR read at 21752-21767); only `attempt_merge` reuses the payload.
  WHY: The same PR is fetched twice, and the timeline walked twice, on each applicable judge tick, which may conflict with the "no extra API calls" constraint. Severity is disputed: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite (which filed it under both CORRECTNESS and PERFORMANCE) and openai_gpt-6-luna rate it MAJOR (high), while z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rates it NIT (low) as a missed-reuse opportunity, not a regression, because pre-PR `attempt_merge` also ran `_resolve_issue_implementation_pr` in the same tick. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined it: the code is not from the last run, the usual judge→attempt_merge path keeps the same API call count, and the extra calls are a small constant cost only on non-merge judge ticks. The highest severity, high, is used here.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The issue asks the skip to "log a structured `STANDALONE_STALL ... outcome=skip reason=linked_pr_merged` line" (implemented as `STALL_SKIP ... reason=linked_pr_merged`, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25327), and "Add tests using the #823 / #825 shape". A test must exercise the path where the linked PR merged into a target/default branch.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, a sibling of `test_standalone_ready_to_merge_skips_recovery_when_linked_pr_merged_into_integration_branch` (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:15363), using a target-base PR (e.g. pr_overrides adding `baseRefName: "main"` to _MERGED_PR_9482)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The only matches of `reason=linked_pr_merged` in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py` are at `:15378` and `:15459`, both `not in result["stdout"]` assertions (the integration-branch skip test and test_standalone_ready_to_merge_open_linked_pr_still_attempts_merge). The `_run_standalone_ready_to_merge_tick_9482` helper hard-codes `baseRefName: "orchestrator/project-768"`, so `_pr_json_base_is_target_merge` returns 1 for every new test and the reconcile always takes the non-target path at line 23634. As a result, the conditional echo at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25326-25328 (moved and gated in the last run) is never run under test. The suggested assertions are: "STALL_SKIP issue=823 reason=linked_pr_merged pr=825 phase=ai:ready-to-merge" appears in stdout, result["stdout"].count("STALL_SKIP issue=823 ") == 1, the `merged_non_target_base` line is absent, and stall_recovery_count is unchanged.
- requirement: Document the new stable STALL_SKIP reason `linked_pr_merged` next to the existing `merged_non_target_base` inventory. The plan's `files_touched` included `agents.d/*`, and the `agents.md:1639` prose block (`Standalone stall recovery and non-target merges (PR #7709)`) lists `merged_non_target_base` but not the new reason.
  expected_change_site: A new `agents.d/9482-stall-skip-linked-pr-merged.md` (or `agents.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md`) fragment targeting the `Standalone stall recovery and non-target merges (PR #7709)` section at agents.md:1639, or the `Stable log prefixes` context for `STALL_SKIP`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `grep -n "reason=linked_pr_merged" agents.md` returns no matches, `ls agents.d/9482*` / `agents.d/*9482*` is empty, and the only prose mentions of the new reason are `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25327` (the echo site) and `changelog.d/9482-standalone-stall-merged-linked-pr.md`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined this gap: the issue does not ask for documentation, the plan grant lists agents.d/* only as an allowed path, and the changelog fragment already describes both reasons.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The issue asks the merged-PR skip to "log a structured STANDALONE_STALL ... outcome=skip reason=linked_pr_merged line". After the last run, that line is printed only when the reconcile did not print its own merged_non_target_base line (target/default-branch merge, unknown base, or unavailable default branch).
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, next to test_standalone_ready_to_merge_skips_recovery_when_linked_pr_merged_into_integration_branch. The test would build a variant of _run_standalone_ready_to_merge_tick_9482 with a target-branch base (pr_overrides adding baseRefName "main" to _MERGED_PR_9482). It would assert that "STALL_SKIP issue=823 reason=linked_pr_merged pr=825 phase=ai:ready-to-merge" appears in stdout, that result["stdout"].count("STALL_SKIP issue=823 ") == 1, and that stall_recovery_count is unchanged.
  Evidence of absence: Every test that mentions reason=linked_pr_merged asserts it is absent. The helper always uses baseRefName "orchestrator/project-768", so the reconcile always takes the non-target path at line 23634, and the conditional echo at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25326-25328 is never run by a test.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, invoke_stall_judge, the escalation guard at lines 22139-22144. The "kept" notice does not say why the guard trusted the PR. Suggested fix: add the head ref to the notice, e.g. "linked PR #${target_pr} (head=${head_ref:-unknown}) is ${pr_state}" (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE: Checked and found no defect in three places:
  - The escalation guard at 22139-22144: `_pr_json_is_issue_implementation_pr` (line 22934) returns 1 on an empty or "{}" payload, so a failed fetch fails safe.
  - The STALL_SKIP echo moved after `_reconcile_standalone_merged_pr_issue` (line 25327): STALL_MERGED_PR_NUM is assigned only at 23269/23291, so it cannot change before the echo.
  - `_STALL_STANDALONE_NT_SKIP_LOGGED`: reset at 23593 before the early returns at 23599, 23614 and 23631, and set only at 23634. It has no identifier collision (found only at 23583, 23593, 23634 and 25326).
- NOTE: Declined two pass-1 items:
  - The duplicate-lookup finding at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25290-25304: not from the last run, the usual path keeps the same API call count (attempt_merge reuses the resolved PR at lines 25973-25978), and the cost is small and constant.
  - The agents.md/agents.d documentation gap: not required by the issue.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py (sibling test case for target-base merge).
  Evidence of absence: No test in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py contains `reason=linked_pr_merged` in a positive assertion. All matches are negative assertions.

- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 22139-22144. Where `target_pr` (`_issue_cross_ref_pr_number_last`) and `linked_pr_json` come from is implicit. Suggested fix: add a comment saying both refer to the implementation PR payload being validated. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
